personality_one_liner: An exclusive cinematic hospitality club pairing secure digital privilege wallets,anti-misuse discounts, and direct VIP manager concierge.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic padding with crisp vertical rhythm and fixed bottom action bars.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and bottom tabs
Apply translucent tinted glass for featured privilege cards
Ensure strong 75%+ opacity underlay for text readability on glass
dont's: Never blur body input fields or long lists
Never stack more than 2 blur surfaces on the same screen

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Cinematic hospitality portal displaying membership status, active privilege wallet, featured buffet/combo deals, and quick concierge access.

states.loading: Skeleton shimmer over cinematic banner and privilege cards
states.empty: No active events or promotional banners found. Tap to refresh gallery.
states.error: Failed to sync membership vault. Tap Retry to reconnect securely.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with safe-area padding. Features top gold-accented membership card, horizontal privilege wallet quick-access, curated buffet deals carousel, promotion gallery teaser, and sticky glass bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Privileges Club
screens.purpose: Run the customer privileges club with dynamic digital membership card, secure PIN/QR redemption against misuse, and tier progress.

states.empty: No membership tier assigned. Contact host to enroll.
states.error: Unable to verify privileges. Please check network connection.

screens.layout: Flippable digital card with gold holographic foil simulation, anti-misuse live countdown timer QR code for counter verification, privilege perks breakdown, and redemption history log.

screens.name: Discounts & Offers
screens.purpose: Manage in-house discounts, buffet deals, and restaurant combos with strict anti-misuse controls and secure voucher codes.

states.empty: No active discounts currently available for your tier.
states.error: Failed to load culinary offers. Tap Retry.

screens.layout: Segmented control filtering between In-House Discounts, Buffet Specials, and Combos. Cards feature high-res gourmet imagery with vertical gradient scrims, countdown badges, and secure 'Generate Single-Use Code' CTA.

screens.name: Concierge Managers
screens.purpose: Connect directly with venue managers for banqueting, private dining, corporate bookings, and personalized inquiries.

states.empty: All managers currently engaged. Leave a callback request.
states.error: Manager desk unreachable. Use direct WhatsApp support.

screens.layout: Direct manager profile cards with status indicators (Available for Banquet / In Dining), WhatsApp direct link, calendar schedule picker, and direct inquiry submission form.

screens.name: Promotion Gallery
screens.purpose: Immersive visual promotion gallery showcasing organization offerings, upcoming events, and festival greetings.

states.empty: Gallery currently empty. Check back soon for new festival announcements.
states.error: Failed to load promotion gallery. Tap Retry.

screens.layout: Masonry/Grid view of high-resolution hospitality scenes, festival greetings, and event posters with fullscreen lightbox modal support.

hero_banner.alt: Cinematic luxury lounge and bar atmosphere

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement all 6 key functionalities seamlessly: 1) Customer Privileges Club with digital membership card; 2) Secure In-House discount management with anti-misuse 60-second dynamic OTP / QR verification; 3) Buffet deals & restaurant combo catalog with redemption flows; 4) Concierge manager connection for banqueting & private events; 5) Festival greetings & event notifications center; 6) Immersive promotion gallery. Maintain 6 Glass/Luxe dark aesthetic with Playfair Display headings and DM Sans body text. Strictly follow safe-area insets, sticky bottom CTAs, and WCAG AA contrast rules.
